def test_create_in_csv_with_headers(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        """Test create_in() CSV with explicit headers."""
        content = [[c.ParserBooleanToken.ONE, "2"], ["3", "4"]]
        path = FlextTestsFiles(base_dir=tmp_path).create(
            content,
            "data.csv",
            options=FlextTestsFiles.CreateOptions(headers=["col1", "col2"]),
        )
        tm.ok(path.exists())
        lines = path.read_text().strip().split("\n")
        tm.that(lines[0], eq="col1,col2")
        tm.that(len(lines), eq=3)

def test_get_file_info_exists(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        """Test getting file info for existing file."""
        manager = FlextTestsFiles(base_dir=tmp_path)
        content = "line1\nline2\nline3"
        file_path = manager.create(content, "test.txt")
        result = manager.info(file_path)
        _ = u.Tests.assert_success(result)
        file_info = result.value
        tm.that(file_info, is_=FlextTestsFiles.FileInfo)

        tm.ok(file_info.is_empty is False)
        tm.that(file_info.first_line, eq="line1")

def test_info_parse_content_csv(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
